name: PDF Image Extractor
author: PiSaucer
description: Extract embedded images from PDF files and remove exact duplicates.
long_description: Uses Poppler's pdfimages utility to preserve supported embedded image formats, then compares SHA-256 hashes and removes byte-for-byte duplicates. Supports custom output directories, duplicate-reporting dry runs, paths containing spaces, and locating pdfimages beside the script or on PATH across Linux, macOS, and Windows.
